description: Study notes: summary, outline, concepts, definitions, code, review questions, unclear points.

sections.instructions: The thread of the lecture in plain sentences: what is taught, in which order and why.
The topics in the order they are taught, each with the line where it starts.
The ideas the lecturer explains, each in a few sentences.
The terms the lecturer defines, in the lecturer's wording with only the spoken fillers removed.
Code the lecturer reads aloud or names, written as in a source file. An example the lecturer only describes in words has an empty "code": never write code for it.
Questions a student can answer from this lecture alone, each with its answer from the lecture and a difficulty.
Points the lecturer leaves unexplained or defers, and passages where the transcript looks misrecognised.
